units.rawText: <cmdr>... Why, why did things end up like this?
units.displayText: {교수}... Why, why did things end up like this?

spans.text: ... Why, why did things end up like this?

units.rawText: Why? It was only supposed to be three years, but then three more years passed, and then three more after that. It's been almost ten years for me, Big Sis...
units.displayText: Why? It was only supposed to be three years, but then three more years passed, and then three more after that. It's been almost ten years for me, Big Sis...

spans.text: Why? It was only supposed to be three years, but then three more years passed, and then three more after that. It's been almost ten years for me, Big Sis...

units.rawText: <cmdr>...
Every day, every day I told myself, I'm a spy, I'm a spy, I'm a spy!
units.displayText: Every day, every day I told myself, I'm a spy, I'm a spy, I'm a spy!

spans.text: Every day, every day I told myself, I'm a spy, I'm a spy,
I'm a spy!

units.rawText: But I got rid of batch after batch of people until it became second nature... Tell me, Big Sis, can I even go back to the force?
units.displayText: But I got rid of batch after batch of people until it became second nature... Tell me, Big Sis, can I even go back to the force?

spans.text: But I got rid of batch after batch of people until it became second nature... Tell me, Big Sis, can I even go back to the force?

units.rawText: Only you can answer that question. If you still believe in the oath you swore when you joined...
units.displayText: Only you can answer that question. If you still believe in the oath you swore when you joined...

spans.text: Only you can answer that question. If you still believe in the oath you swore when you joined...

units.rawText: If you still believe in justice... Then grab your gun and let's close this damn case.
units.displayText: If you still believe in justice... Then grab your gun and let's close this damn case.

spans.text: If you still believe in justice... Then grab your gun and let's close this damn case.

units.rawText: CUT! Perfect. Xinghuan, Professor, thank you very much.
units.displayText: CUT! Perfect. Xinghuan, Professor, thank you very much.

spans.text: CUT! Perfect. Xinghuan, Professor, thank you very much.

units.rawText: Whew... At last, it's over... Hm?
units.displayText: Whew... At last, it's over... Hm?

spans.text: Whew... At last, it's over... Hm?

units.rawText: Although we've finished shooting this scene, Xinghuan is still eying me with a smile on her face.
units.displayText: Although we've finished shooting this scene, Xinghuan is still eying me with a smile on her face.

spans.text: Although we've finished shooting this scene, Xinghuan is still eying me with a smile on her face.

units.rawText: Xinghuan? What's going on?
units.displayText: Xinghuan? What's going on?

spans.text: Xinghuan? What's going on?

units.rawText: Ah.. Ah, it's nothing. Just... When you call me "Big Sis" my heart skips a little.
units.displayText: Ah.. Ah, it's nothing. Just... When you call me "Big Sis" my heart skips a little.

spans.text: Ah.. Ah, it's nothing. Just... When you call me "Big Sis" my heart skips a little.

units.rawText: I never thought the day would come when I could play the Professor's senior.
units.displayText: I never thought the day would come when I could play the Professor's senior.

spans.text: I never thought the day would come when I could play the Professor's senior.

units.rawText: Well, the role of a righteous senior does suit you, Xinghuan.
units.displayText: Well, the role of a righteous senior does suit you, Xinghuan.

spans.text: Well, the role of a righteous senior does suit you, Xinghuan.

units.rawText: Hehehe, really? Well, in that case...
units.displayText: Hehehe, really? Well, in that case...

spans.text: Hehehe, really? Well, in that case...

units.rawText: Professor~ Could you call me that one more time?
units.displayText: Professor~ Could you call me that one more time?

spans.text: Professor~ Could you call me that one more time?

units.rawText: Er...
units.displayText: Er...

spans.text: Er...

units.rawText: Come on, just once?
units.displayText: Come on, just once?

spans.text: Come on, just once?

units.rawText: Although Xinghuan is looking at me with expectant eyes, it really is hard to say it when we're off the set.
units.displayText: Although Xinghuan is looking at me with expectant eyes, it really is hard to say it when we're off the set.

spans.text: Although Xinghuan is looking at me with expectant eyes, it really is hard to say it when we're off the set.

units.rawText: And if someone else heard us...
units.displayText: And if someone else heard us...

spans.text: And if someone else heard us...

units.rawText: Ahem, the shoot's over, so we should head over to the next set... hm?
units.displayText: Ahem, the shoot's over, so we should head over to the next set... hm?

spans.text: Ahem, the shoot's over, so we should head over to the next set... hm?

units.rawText: Just as I'm about to get up and leave, I realize that the ropes behind me have not been untied.
units.displayText: Just as I'm about to get up and leave, I realize that the ropes behind me have not been untied.

spans.text: Just as I'm about to get up and leave, I realize that the ropes behind me have not been untied.

units.rawText: Wait, the crew didn't untie the ropes for me? How careless... Xinghuan, lend me a hand... er...
units.displayText: Wait, the crew didn't untie the ropes for me? How careless... Xinghuan, lend me a hand... er...

spans.text: Wait, the crew didn't untie the ropes for me? How careless... Xinghuan, lend me a hand... er...

units.rawText: Hehehe~ Professor, you need to ask in the proper way~
units.displayText: Hehehe~ Professor, you need to ask in the proper way~

spans.text: Hehehe~ Professor, you need to ask in the proper way~

units.rawText: Xinghuan drags a chair over and sits down on it while cupping her chin in bemusement.
units.displayText: Xinghuan drags a chair over and sits down on it while cupping her chin in bemusement.

spans.text: Xinghuan drags a chair over and sits down on it while cupping her chin in bemusement.

units.rawText: Um... Please help me undo the ropes?
units.displayText: Um... Please help me undo the ropes?

spans.text: Um... Please help me undo the ropes?

units.rawText: Hehehe, Professor, you know that's not what I want to hear.
units.displayText: Hehehe, Professor, you know that's not what I want to hear.

spans.text: Hehehe, Professor, you know that's not what I want to hear.

units.rawText: The crew have all left, and now we're the only two people remaining.
units.displayText: The crew have all left, and now we're the only two people remaining.

spans.text: The crew have all left, and now we're the only two people remaining.

units.rawText: You can shout until your voice goes hoarse but nobody will come to save you~
units.displayText: You can shout until your voice goes hoarse but nobody will come to save you~

spans.text: You can shout until your voice goes hoarse but nobody will come to save you~

units.rawText: If you don't say the words I want to hear, I won't let you go.
units.displayText: If you don't say the words I want to hear, I won't let you go.

spans.text: If you don't say the words I want to hear, I won't let you go.

units.rawText: ...It looks like this trustworthy and righteous senior of mine has a hidden side to her as well...
units.displayText: ...It looks like this trustworthy and righteous senior of mine has a hidden side to her as well...
